# Automatic recall watch

Boss, 2026-09-30: automatic mdkb recall on every prompt, no shadow week; watch it and track the problems.
Started 2026-09-30 11:25. Explicit `require_sigil = false` in 8 repo configs (itview, devstracker, gate-os, monfumo,
twitter, ai-team-evolution, cerebro, ego); code default flips with mdkb 192-dfe3.

Check every 2 h: `outcome` and payload sizes of `user_prompt_submit` rows in each repo's `.mdkb/hook-events.jsonl`,
the Recall section of `mdkb stats` (precision by cosine band once 30 candidates are labelled), and the injections
seen in coordinator turns. Rerank (mdkb 202, IT on, EN off; Boss, 2026-10-01): count `rerank_outcome` per prompt
language and log Italian prompts that reach rerank with their scores; they calibrate the EN threshold. A problem is: an injected entry unrelated to the prompt, stale or refuted content,
